theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.kzExchange_shadow_involution :
kzExchange 0 * kzExchange 0 = 1

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.flip_mul_flip :
flip * flip = 1

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.kzExchange_zero :
kzExchange 0 = flip

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.kzExchange_quad (c : ℂ) :
kzExchange c * kzExchange c = (Complex.exp c - (Complex.exp c)⁻¹) • kzExchange c + 1

noncomputable def QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.kzExchange (c : ℂ) :
Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℂ

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.exchange_hecke (c : ℂ) :
(Complex.exp (c / 2) • (flip * halfMonodromy c) - Complex.exp c • 1) * (Complex.exp (c / 2) • (flip * halfMonodromy c) + (Complex.exp c)⁻¹ • 1) = 0

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.real_q_admissible (q : ℝ) (hq : 1 < q) :
Complex.exp ↑(Real.log q) ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.trace_weight_exchange_pow (c : ℂ) (hq : Complex.exp c ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
(weightKK (Complex.exp c) * (flip * halfMonodromy c) ^ k).trace = Complex.exp (-c / 2) ^ k * (weightKK (Complex.exp c) * rCheck (Complex.exp c) ^ k).trace

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.exchange_eq_conj_rCheck (c : ℂ) (hq : Complex.exp c ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) :
flip * halfMonodromy c = Complex.exp (-c / 2) • (conjInv (Complex.exp c) * rCheck (Complex.exp c) * conj (Complex.exp c))

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.exchange_eq_classical (c : ℂ) :
flip * halfMonodromy c = Complex.exp (-c / 2) • classicalExchange (Complex.exp c)

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.transport_one (c : ℂ) (x : Fin 4 → ℂ) :
transport c 1 x = (halfMonodromy c).mulVec x

noncomputable def QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.halfMonodromy (c : ℂ) :
Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℂ

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.kz_solution_unique (c : ℂ) (x : Fin 4 → ℂ) (F : ℝ → Fin 4 → ℂ) (hF : ∀ (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt F (c • casimir.mulVec (F t)) t) (h0 : F 0 = x) :
Set.EqOn F (fun (t : ℝ) => transport c t x) (Set.Icc 0 1)

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.transport_zero (c : ℂ) (x : Fin 4 → ℂ) :
transport c 0 x = x

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.transport_hasDerivAt (c : ℂ) (x : Fin 4 → ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
HasDerivAt (fun (s : ℝ) => transport c s x) (c • casimir.mulVec (transport c t x)) t

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.casimir_mulVec_transport (c : ℂ) (t : ℝ) (x : Fin 4 → ℂ) :
casimir.mulVec (transport c t x) = (Complex.exp (c * ↑t / 2) / 2) • x + (-3 / 2 * Complex.exp (-3 * c * ↑t / 2) - 1 / 2 * Complex.exp (c * ↑t / 2)) • antiProj.mulVec x

noncomputable def QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.transport (c : ℂ) (t : ℝ) (x : Fin 4 → ℂ) :
Fin 4 → ℂ

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.halfTurn_logDeriv (w₀ : ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
HasDerivAt (fun (s : ℝ) => w₀ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ↑Real.pi * ↑s)) (Complex.I * ↑Real.pi * (w₀ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ↑Real.pi * ↑t))) t

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.classicalExchange_hecke {R : Type u_1} [Field R] [CharZero R] {q : R} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
(classicalExchange q - q • 1) * (classicalExchange q + q⁻¹ • 1) = 0

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.trace_weight_classicalExchange_pow {R : Type u_1} [Field R] [CharZero R] {q : R} (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
(weightKK q * classicalExchange q ^ k).trace = (weightKK q * rCheck q ^ k).trace

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.classicalExchange_eq_conj {R : Type u_1} [Field R] [CharZero R] {q : R} (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) :
classicalExchange q = conjInv q * rCheck q * conj q

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.rCheck_mul_conj {R : Type u_1} [Field R] [CharZero R] {q : R} (hq0 : q ≠ 0) :
rCheck q * conj q = conj q * classicalExchange q

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.conj_commute_weight {R : Type u_1} [Field R] [CharZero R] (q : R) :
conj q * weightKK q = weightKK q * conj q

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.conjInv_mul_conj {R : Type u_1} [Field R] [CharZero R] {q : R} (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) :
conjInv q * conj q = 1

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.conj_mul_conjInv {R : Type u_1} [Field R] [CharZero R] {q : R} (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) :
conj q * conjInv q = 1

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.qq_ne {R : Type u_1} [Field R] [CharZero R] {q : R} (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) :
q + q⁻¹ ≠ 0

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.casimir_eq_flip {R : Type u_1} [Field R] [CharZero R] :
casimir = flip - (1 / 2) • 1

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.flip_eq {R : Type u_1} [Field R] [CharZero R] :
flip = 1 - 2 • antiProj

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.casimir_eq {R : Type u_1} [Field R] [CharZero R] :
casimir = (1 / 2) • 1 - 2 • antiProj

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoTwoPoint.antiProj_mul_self {R : Type u_1} [Field R] [CharZero R] :
antiProj * antiProj = antiProj
